what_i_see: A small spiral galaxy with a bright core and a straight, narrow spur about 3 arcsec long leaving its north-east side. The spur is distinctly redder than the bluish disc and has its own faint knot.
most_likely: An edge-on red companion or background galaxy overlapping the spiral's edge, or a short tidal tail from a minor merger.
decisive_test: Separate photometry or spectrum of the spur: a different redshift means chance overlap, same redshift means tidal feature.
catalogue_notes: Legacy photo-z 0.37±0.12 at 0.75 arcsec (extended). SIMBAD: nothing within 60; NED nearest WISEA source 22.1. Gaia none within 16. Four lens lists: no match within 60.
